lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular 2D grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and six vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a localized grid of anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal linear features are visible across the upper third of the flank, defined by a distinct light-to-shadow vertical gradient indicating structural ridges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a low-density distribution of approximately 10 to 14 high-luminance blobs, primarily concentrated toward the anterior margin and base.

other_distinctive_markers: A sharp transition in spot morphology is observed from high-density, small-diameter punctate clusters on the cranial region to low-density, large-diameter blobs on the lateral flank.
